summary: Backend-only testing of the new offsite-backup HEALTH alert system in /app/backend/backups.py. All 10 pytest tests PASS (100%). Verified: GET /api/admin/backup-health returns the documented JSON shape with health/alert_state/recipients/reminder_days; health.healthy is currently False with reason 'expired' (Drive token expired), confirming the live state. POST /api/admin/backup-health/run-now?test=true successfully sent a sample alert email via Gmail SMTP to MechanicLTZ@gmail.com (ok=true, sent_to includes admin). POST /api/admin/backup-health/run-now (no test param) returns {test:false, alert_sent, health, recipients} with health.healthy=false as expected. Auth gating is correct: 401 with no token, 403 with non-admin token. Regression: /api/admin/gdrive/status returns 200, and /api/admin/gdrive/oauth-callback (no code) returns 400 (NOT 404), proving the fixed GDRIVE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI route is live on the current domain.
critical_code_review_comments: backups.py is 891 lines — close to the 700-line guideline soft limit; consider splitting Drive-OAuth endpoints, scheduler, and health-alert logic into separate modules if it grows further.

In _maybe_send_backup_alert (line ~393), the 'due' calculation when state has no last_email_at sets due=False first (via bool(last) and ...) and only flips to True on the next line — minor readability issue but logically correct.

Health-alert reminder window logic relies on system_config doc with _id='backup_alert_state'; ensure system_config collection is included in BACKUP_COLLECTIONS if needed (currently it is NOT — alert state is not backed up, which is acceptable but worth noting).
seed_data_creation: Created one transient non-admin user (testuser_<uuid>@example.com / Test12345!) per test run for 403 gating verification. No persistent seed data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_backup_health.py is reusable. It uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) and admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Note: every run of the test=true case sends a REAL email to MechanicLTZ@gmail.com (intentional, per E1's spec). The 'no test param' case may also dispatch a real alert email when Drive is down (currently it is) — also intentional and throttled by ALERT_REMINDER_DAYS=7 in DB doc system_config._id=backup_alert_state.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validates a newly built feature; no bugs found. Original 404 on OAuth reconnect was caused by stale GDRIVE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI in backend/.env pointing at an old fork domain; fix is confirmed live: GET /api/admin/gdrive/oauth-callback now returns 400 (route present) instead of 404, on the current domain login-stretch-layout.preview.emergentagent.com.
